title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
goal: Solve Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix: Exploit sorted matrix rows and columns to locate the kth value without treating repeated values as one item.
strategy: Exploit sorted matrix rows and columns to locate the kth value without treating repeated values as one item.
edgeCases: Duplicate entries count separately toward k; k is a rank among cells, not distinct values.
